label: MiniMax H3 (video)
loader_note: The file is comfy-quantized int8, so the fingerprinter reaches for OTUNetLoaderW8A8; the workflow these outputs came from loads it on the plain UNETLoader, which handles .comfy_quant itself. loader_class pins that.
frames_note: Frame count is max(min_frames, round(duration*fps)) rounded UP to the next value congruent to min_frames mod frame_chunk -- 5s at 24fps is 124 frames, which is what the source workflow's ComfyMathExpression computed.
